verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser ships a software product, Visalaw AI, so asking whether its API matches the UI is a fair question. The evidence pack never mentions a public API, SDK or programmatic access, and the OpenAPI and llms.txt probes all returned 404. Marketing claims about automating workflows describe in-app use, not API parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
